name: Kelwyn Pellwyn
keeps: the checkpoint, and what it was taken over
does: Replays the chain from nothing and says whether the balance is the sum of the events. Signs when it is.
reason: His letter to his daughter survives, written from the cell: the confession was false and extracted, and he said so in writing while he still could.
text: Kelwyn pellwyn of the quiet lamp, keeps the book for the 13th tranche, doors 115 to 123. Keeps the checkpoint, and what it was taken over. Reads Johannes Junius.
